scope: Read-only source audit and public documentation retrieval. This file is evidence only; no implementation, business endpoint calls, authority outcomes or acceptance promotion.
retrievalMethod: Unauthenticated HTTPS GET of public documentation with Python urllib; SHA-256 covers raw response bytes. No provider business API was called. Remote bytes were inspected in memory and are not retained in this evidence file.

authorityContract.pathsHashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(spec['paths'], sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) with default ensure_ascii=True.
findings: No operation-status or discovery GET by RF idempotency key or main-form reference appears in either inspected OpenAPI paths object.
RF prose documents identical-body, same-key POST replay returning the same response; it does not specify replay lifetime, expiry, deduplication namespace or concurrency semantics.
The confirmation header discrepancy remains: general replay prose versus no idempotencyKey parameter on bekreft. Omission does not prove the server ignores the header.
GLD_019 reports a previously used key but does not establish success or nonexecution. Missing documents and prefill are not exact operation-status evidence.
authorityContract.priorResearchCorrection: unknown-outcome-recovery-research-20260930.md correctly recorded the earlier inspection, but its statement that no later version is listed is no longer current: unpublished 1.3.0 is now listed. Published/default 1.2.0 and its bytes remain unchanged.

facts: End-user GET /api/v1/enduser/dialogs supports party/serviceResource filtering and continuation-token pagination; results depend on current authorization.
Dialog lookup accepts Altinn instance, correspondence and dialog identifiers. The inspected documentation does not accept an RF idempotency key or main-form reference.
Transmissions provide immutable IDs and optional relatedTransmissionId. Unauthorized transmissions may be excluded.
dialogportenLimits.inference: A bounded search can yield investigation candidates, but no inspected RF contract binds its exact operation key/main reference to searchable Dialogporten fields. Matching company/year/XML, one visible candidate or an empty result cannot prove one logical submission executed or did not execute.

existingLocalRecovery.case: Committed source or register capture; client lost receipt
existingLocalRecovery.invariant: Unique company/year/actor/key identity; canonical request digest and immutable original snapshot. Existing same-key capture replay returns the original matching receipt, including a superseded version.
existingLocalRecovery.gap: Current workflow refreshes Documents/Governance before reaching the replay lookup (application/shareholder_register_source_workflow.py:564 and :603). A dedicated read-only lookup can retrieve committed evidence despite later source changes without repeating capture.

existingLocalRecovery.case: Committed source submission claim; client lost response
existingLocalRecovery.invariant: Exact approval/manifest/predecessor/actor identity recovers the existing claim before new admission; recovery grants no provider POST.

existingLocalRecovery.case: Committed authority success; client lost response
existingLocalRecovery.invariant: Read-only retained position reconstructs committed successes. Send execution skips succeeded operations; all mutations succeeded yields confirmed. Continuing a later, never-started operation requires its own current admission.

existingLocalRecovery.case: Committed confirmation; authority feedback not yet retained
existingLocalRecovery.invariant: Existing read-only reconciliation requires retained confirmation dialog/transmission references and exact approved source lineage. It does not discover an unknown mutation.

existingLocalRecovery.case: Prepared intent or unknown authority outcome
existingLocalRecovery.invariant: No new send grant for prepared/unknown; immutable outcomes cannot be overwritten with invented success. A retryable known failure may receive one newly admitted serialized intent, original key, maximum 20 attempts. An abandoned prepared intent cannot prove whether I/O ran.

safeLocalFollowUp.owner: shareholder_register_filing owns typed query, canonical request identity, persistence and receipt validation; application authenticates actor/current owner; generated API transport and web only present results.
safeLocalFollowUp.contract: Separate bounded read-only capture-attempt lookup using original strict capture request plus original Idempotency-Key, server-derived actor, company/year and capture kind. Return recorded with exact original receipt or not_observed. Conflict/unavailable remain distinct. No source refresh, write, new key, capture call or authority call.
safeLocalFollowUp.absenceSemantics: not_observed is not proof that an original request has completed or cannot later commit. It does not authorize a fresh key, changed body, automatic capture retry or any authority mutation.
testsRequired: Database: committed receipt after response loss and after supersession/current evidence change; exact key/body; conflicting request; foreign actor/company concealment; revoked owner; concurrent pending commit/rollback; zero writes.

API: strict existing request DTO and original key; server-derived actor; bounded deadline; no-cache response; recorded/not_observed/conflict/unavailable distinction; no provider or Documents/Governance calls.

UI: uncertain attempt retains original body/key; explicit lookup; only valid recorded receipt resolves it; not_observed/conflict/outage preserve uncertainty; no automatic duplicate capture POST/new key; source/register separation.

prohibitedInferences: Main reference can manufacture confirmation references
A timeout or malformed successful response permits a fresh key
externalUnknownOutcome.neededBeforeAutomaticResolution: Authoritative positive correlation to the exact original operation, or an explicitly established safe replay contract covering environment, credential identity, method/path/query, exact bytes/key, retention and confirmation. No numeric retry window is established by inspected documents.
externalUnknownOutcome.futureStorageRule: Any future externally justified resolution needs an append-only owned resolution contract, concurrency/admission control and archive compatibility; the existing single-outcome invariant cannot safely be bypassed or overwritten.
